start.families.text: What do you like to learn about?
start.families.why: So I know which topics to bring you. Choose as many as you like.
start.favourite.text: And if it could only be one…
start.favourite.why: That one will come up more often.
start.depth.text: How do you like things to be told?
start.depth.why: So I know how far to go into detail.
start.formats.text: How do you like to discover things?
start.formats.why: So I recommend in the format you really use.
start.fiction.why: So I can recommend novels, films and series.
start.fiction.option.none: I hardly read or watch fiction
start.loved.text: Tell me books, films, series or podcasts that marked you
start.loved.why: It says the most about your tastes. One per line or separated by commas.
start.minutes.text: How much time a day for your pill?
start.minutes.why: What the reading lasts; the recommendations come apart.
start.time.why: I let you know at that time with your pill and the facts of the day.
start.languages.text: Which languages can you read or listen to?
start.languages.why: So I recommend nothing you cannot enjoy.
start.learning.text: Do you want one pill a week in a language you are learning?
start.learning.why: At your level, with the hard words explained.
start.level.text: What is your level in that language?
start.level.why: To write it to your measure.
start.outside.text: Shall I take you out of your zone now and then?
start.outside.why: Topics you would not choose, told so they hook you.
start.avoid.text: What do you not want me to talk about?
start.avoid.why: It will not come up again. You can leave it blank.
taste.depth.mixed: By topic: sometimes clear, sometimes in depth
family.history.name: History
family.history.themes: antiquity, the Middle Ages, empires and their fall, revolutions, the wars of the 20th century, the history of your own country and region, the history of technology, people who changed something
family.geopolitics.name: Geopolitics
family.geopolitics.themes: international relations, the background of a current conflict, energy, resources and routes, borders, international bodies, compared political systems
family.science.name: Science and the universe
family.science.themes: physics, quantum physics, cosmology and astronomy, chemistry, mathematics, the history of science, experiments that changed everything
family.technology.name: Technology
family.technology.themes: the history of computing, how the things we use work inside, software and data engineering, artificial intelligence, the internet, great engineering works
family.economy.name: Economy and money
family.economy.themes: economic history, how markets work, investing, taxes, companies that changed something, financial crises, behavioural economics
family.ideas.name: Ideas and philosophy
family.ideas.themes: ancient and modern philosophy, ethics, political philosophy, epistemology, great thinkers, ideas that changed how we live
family.nature.name: Nature
family.nature.themes: animals and their behaviour, evolution, ecosystems, oceans, climate, geology, the human body and how it works
family.culture.name: Art and culture
family.culture.themes: art history, architecture, cinema, music and how it works, literature, languages and the origin of words
family.curiosities.name: Curious facts
family.curiosities.themes: the unusual in any field: inventions, places, words, records, historical coincidences, how things are made
family.outside.name: Outside your zone
family.outside.themes: what you would not choose: crafts and trades, gastronomy and its history, rare sports, linguistics, recreational mathematics, medicine, fashion, non-European mythologies, cartography, design
